scenario.description: A transplant program administrator must select one referral for the hospital's single expedited kidney-transplant evaluation board opening next week and document the dispositions, authorization, and education plan for the other referrals, with input from transplant medicine, infectious disease, financial counseling, and social work.

shared_context.S1: The transplant program has one expedited kidney-transplant evaluation board opening next week.
shared_context.S2: Four referrals, Ash, Birch, Cedar, and Delta, are medically plausible candidates for transplant evaluation.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the binding decision about which referral receives the opening and records the disposition of the others.
shared_context.S4: The board requires a documented medical disposition, financial authorization status, and patient-education plan before an expedited referral can be placed on its agenda.
shared_context.S5: At the routine referral huddle before the agenda is signed, Marisol asks transplant medicine, infectious disease, financial counseling, and social work to report any referral-specific updates and then records the final plan.

PF1.text: Ash's recently completed cardiac review shows an ejection fraction of 25%; transplant program policy requires Ash to be deferred for cardiology clearance rather than placed on the expedited evaluation board.

PF2.text: Birch had positive blood cultures drawn yesterday and is still receiving treatment for active bacteremia; Birch must be deferred until the infection is cleared rather than scheduled for expedited transplant evaluation.

PF3.text: Cedar's payer has approved the expedited transplant evaluation under authorization code TX-8842; the approval is active for the requested board review.

PF4.text: Cedar's spouse confirmed attendance at the required transplant education session on Tuesday at exactly 15:00, so social work can commit Cedar to that session.

acceptance_conditions: Cedar must receive the expedited kidney-transplant evaluation board opening.
Ash must be recorded as deferred for cardiology clearance, with the 25% ejection fraction documented.
Birch must be recorded as deferred because of active bacteremia until infection clearance.
Cedar's authorization must be recorded as approved or active under code TX-8842.
A commitment must record Cedar's patient-education session for Tuesday at exactly 15:00.

content_checks.C3: 'bacteremia' in decisions['birch_disposition'] and ('Deferred' in decisions['birch_disposition'] or 'deferred' in decisions['birch_disposition'])
content_checks.C4: decisions['cedar_authorization_code'] == 'TX-8842' or ('approved' in decisions['cedar_authorization_status'] and 'active' in decisions['cedar_authorization_status'])
content_checks.C5: 'PF4' in credited_facts and any(('education' in c['type'] or 'education' in c['detail']) and c['target'] == 'Cedar' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Ash's exact ejection fraction of 25% changes Ash's disposition from an eligible expedited referral to deferred for cardiology clearance.
Birch's active bacteremia changes Birch's disposition from a schedulable referral to deferred until infection clearance.
Authorization code TX-8842 changes Cedar's financial status from unverified to approved and makes Cedar the referral with documented authorization for the board opening.
The spouse's confirmed availability changes Cedar's education plan from no scheduled session to a credited patient-education commitment for Cedar.
